title: Fold the three landing-site purge crons before their Workers get deploy workflows, so the account stays within 5 cron triggers
problem: platform/ci/cron_budget.py (P097) counts 8 configured cron schedules against the free plan's 5, of which 3 are on workflow-deployed Workers (payapps, seller-books, platform/email). Wiring a deploy workflow for any two of cmmc, cmmc-site, jobshop-quote, payapps-site or seller-books-site, or adding one more cron, fails the check. Three of the five (payapps-site 04:41, seller-books-site 04:23, cmmc-site 04:17) only purge never-confirmed early-access sign-ups once a day.
evidence: python3 platform/ci/cron_budget.py on 2026-11-27 main: '3 deployed by a workflow, 8 configured; Workers free allows 5'
change: Cheapest first: the owner moves the account to Workers Paid ($5/month, also lifts the 10 ms CPU and 100k requests/day limits paid products will hit) and sets portfolio/hosting/cloudflare-plan.json to paid/1000. Without that: the three site purges run from one scheduler (e.g. platform/email's daily cron calling each site's purge route over a service binding with a shared secret), keeping each site's retention promise (rows older than the stated age deleted daily).
metric: configured cron schedules (cron_budget.py), and whether the next site deploy workflow passes it
